name: claude-caching-at-depth
purpose: getConfigValue('claude.cachingAtDepth', -1, 'number') (chat-completions.js:108-111: an integer >= 0, else -1) gates cachingAtDepthForClaude (:330-332), which walks the converted messages from the END, SKIPS a trailing assistant prefill, counts ROLE CHANGES as depth, and stamps cache_control {type:'ephemeral', ttl:'5m'} on the last content block of the messages at depth === cachingAtDepth and at depth === cachingAtDepth + 2 before breaking (prompt-converters.js:985-1011); :334-337 then appends prompt-caching-2024-07-31 and extended-cache-ttl-2025-04-11 to anthropic-beta. The model is claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 deliberately: it matches none of useThinking / noPrefillModel (:255-260), so :393-394 does NOT flip the trailing assistant turn and the prefill skip in the walk actually applies. DISCRIMINATING BECAUSE: the four non-system turns become converted indices 0..3, the walk skips index 3 as the prefill, and with depth 0 the two stamped messages are exactly index 2 and index 0 -- a Go side that stamped every message, stamped the prefill, or counted messages instead of role changes produces a different body, and anthropic-beta differs from every non-caching claude scenario.
stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.
